summary: Community Milestones, Birthday tools, and 'We've Missed You' backend regression complete — 17/17 pytest cases PASS (100%). Validated: (1) GET /api/milestones/{user_id} returns full shape (user_id/stats/earned/upcoming/just_unlocked) with each milestone carrying key,group,label,emoji,message,threshold,current,progress,earned; Frankie has all 4 required earned (new_member, first_friend, first_game, points_100); 5 groups (Welcome/Activity/Points/Anniversary/Spirit) all represented across earned+upcoming; 404 for unknown user. (2) Once-only notifications: clearing milestones_celebrated then calling /milestones surfaces just_unlocked AND writes a milestone notification per key (verified via Mongo lookup on payload.milestone_key); second call returns just_unlocked=[]. (3) POST /users/{uid}/birthday-visibility — 'off' removes Frank from /community/today birthdays, 'on' restores him, invalid value returns 400. (4) POST /birthday/wishes/send happy path: Maggie→Frank creates a flutter doc + birthday_wish notification (with payload.flutter_id) and awards Maggie +3 points; 403 when recipient visibility='off'; 403 when recipient has blocked the sender; 400 when recipient has no birthday set. (5) POST /jobs/missed-you-check?days_idle=30 idempotent for same day — 3 dormant TEST_ users notified on first call (notification.type='missed_you', body 'Your friends at YouBelong would love to see you again.'), second call leaves notification count at exactly 1 per user (missed_you_last_sent guard works). (6) Regressions all green: /admin/policy returns the 4 keys, /admin/repeat-offenders is admin-gated, /community/today + /games/spot/daily + /games/sudoku/daily return 200, frankie/maggie/joycey demo logins all return access_token. Tests are fully idempotent (run-scoped TEST_milebday_<run-id>_ prefix, teardown deletes disposable users, notifications, flutters; Frank's birthday_visibility restored).
critical_code_review_comments: Milestones idempotency uses $addToSet on milestones_celebrated — clean and race-safe. Notifications are pushed AFTER the celebrated-set update, so a crash mid-flight could result in 'celebrated but no notification'; consider awaiting push_notification first or in a transaction if this matters in production.

POST /birthday/wishes/send always awards +3 points even on re-sends from the same sender — no rate limit/dedupe. A single friend could spam wishes to inflate points. Consider a per-(from,to,YYYY-MM-DD) guard.
GET /community/today birthdays query filters birthday_visibility != 'off' (matches default 'on' for legacy users without the field) — verified by the visibility-off/on toggle test.

missed_you_last_sent uses ws_today_iso() (UTC date string) — idempotency window is one UTC day. Will re-notify the same user the very next UTC day even if days_idle still matches — intended for a daily cron, worth flagging in case ops run it more aggressively.
/admin/repeat-offenders correctly 403s without admin header (also accepts 401/422 in test to be tolerant of FastAPI dependency validation paths).

milestones.py 'evaluate' computes current = int(value(...)) which floors floats — safe given all current values are integer-valued lambdas; just worth noting if a future milestone uses a fractional metric.

Transient 500s observed on /api/milestones BEFORE the test run were due to a stale uvicorn worker that hadn't picked up the milestones import — resolved itself on WatchFiles reload. Not reproducible in the test run. If main agent has not yet committed, ensure `from milestones import MILESTONES as ML_DEFS, evaluate as ml_evaluate` is at module top (line 25 currently — correct).
seed_data_creation: Created 5 disposable users with username prefix TEST_milebday_<run-id>_ (1 blocker, 1 no-birthday, 3 dormant for missed-you). All deleted in teardown along with their notifications/flutters. Frank's birthday_visibility is reset to 'on' and his milestones_celebrated is left cleared (so re-running tests starts from a clean idempotency baseline). Maggie's points snapshot is restored to its pre-test value after the wish-send awards +3. NO canonical demo data is permanently mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_milestones_birthday_missedyou.py. JUnit XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/milestones_birthday_missedyou_results.xml. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_milestones_birthday_missedyou.py -v. Total runtime ~1.85s. Tests assume Frank (frankie demo) has birthday=06-13 in seed and today (UTC) is 06-13; if you run on a different date, the visibility on/off test will fail because Frank won't appear in /community/today birthdays. Adjust by either freezing the date or seeding a different demo whose birthday matches today.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The transient 500 NameError visible in backend.err.log was from an old worker process before the milestones import was applied; the live worker handles /api/milestones cleanly (200 OK confirmed before and during pytest run).
